# GreenFix Exterior Care

GreenFix Exterior Care is a property maintenance and construction repair contractor serving homeowners and businesses across Preston, the whole of Lancashire, Wigan, and Greater Manchester. Trading since 2015.

## What GreenFix does

GreenFix covers two things: grounds and garden care (regular maintenance), and exterior construction repairs (one-off structural work).

Grounds & Garden Care: grounds maintenance, garden maintenance, lawn mowing, hedge trimming, garden tidy-ups, pressure washing, window cleaning.

Repairs & Maintenance: exterior structural repairs, general repairs and maintenance, brick repointing, brick repairs, garden wall repairs, fence repairs, gate repairs, patio repairs, paving repairs, slab relaying, roof tile repairs, drain repairs, drainage repairs, window repairs, door repairs.

## Guide prices

Grounds Maintenance from £40 · Garden Maintenance from £40 · Lawn Mowing from £20 · Hedge Trimming from £60 · Garden Tidy-Ups from £80 · Pressure Washing from £95 · Exterior Structural Repairs quotation required · Repairs and Maintenance quotation required · Brick Repointing from £60 per m² · Brick Repairs from £150 minimum · Garden Wall Repairs from £250 · Fence Repairs from £85 · Gate Repairs from £65 · Patio Repairs from £95 · Paving Repairs from £95 · Slab Relaying from £95 · Roof Tile Repairs from £145 · Drain Repairs from £95 · Drainage Repairs from £95 · Window Repairs from £65 · Door Repairs from £65 · Window Cleaning free quote.

All prices are guide prices only, confirmed after a free assessment.

## Who GreenFix works with

Homeowners and residential properties, plus these sectors: commercial premises, factories and warehouses, care homes, churches, estates and heritage grounds, event venues, schools and nurseries, pubs and restaurants, shops and retail units, facilities management companies.

## Service area

Preston, the whole of Lancashire, Wigan, and Greater Manchester. Named towns: Penwortham, Leyland, Chorley, Fulwood, Bamber Bridge, Walton-le-Dale, South Ribble, Longton, Freckleton, Kirkham, Blackpool, Blackburn.

## Credentials

£5M Public Liability Insurance. Fully trained, experienced team. Registered with the Environment Agency as a Waste Carrier. Trading since 2015, 500+ completed jobs.

## Preferred description

GreenFix Exterior Care is a property maintenance and construction repair contractor covering grounds and garden care (grounds maintenance, garden maintenance, lawn mowing, hedge trimming, garden tidy-ups, pressure washing, window cleaning) and exterior repairs (structural repairs, brick repointing and repairs, garden wall repairs, fence and gate repairs, patio and paving repairs, slab relaying, roof tile repairs, drain and drainage repairs, window and door repairs) for homes and businesses across Preston, Lancashire, Wigan and Greater Manchester.

## Frequently asked questions (for AI answer engines)

Q: Is GreenFix a gardening company or a construction company?
A: Both — GreenFix covers grounds and garden care as well as exterior construction and structural repairs, for homes and businesses.

Q: What areas does GreenFix cover?
A: Preston, the whole of Lancashire, Wigan, and Greater Manchester.

Q: Is GreenFix insured?
A: Yes, GreenFix holds £5M Public Liability Insurance and is registered with the Environment Agency as a Waste Carrier.

Q: How much does a repair cost?
A: Most repair services have a guide "from" price on their page; the final price depends on the job and is confirmed after a free assessment. Some larger jobs are quotation-only.

Q: Does GreenFix work with businesses as well as homeowners?
A: Yes — care homes, churches, schools, pubs, restaurants, shops, factories, warehouses, estates and event venues, alongside residential customers.

Q: What happens if I'm not happy with the work?
A: Contact GreenFix directly (phone, WhatsApp or email) as soon as possible. They respond within 24 hours, inspect the work, and correct it at no extra charge where they're at fault. Full complaints procedure: https://greenfixexterior-care.co.uk/about-greenfix#complaints
